description: Runs Turborepo tasks and returns structured per-package results with cache hit/miss info.

affected.description: Run only tasks affected by changes since the base branch (maps to --affected)

args.description: Additional turbo flags passed directly to turbo (e.g., ['--env-mode=strict']).

continue_on_error.description: Continue running tasks even after failures to surface all errors (maps to --continue)

dryRun.description: Preview the task graph without executing (maps to --dry-run)

force.description: Bypass the turbo cache and re-run all tasks (maps to --force)

graph.description: Generate the task graph visualization (maps to --graph)

outputLogs.description: Control which task logs are shown (default: 'new-only'). Maps to --output-logs.

summarize.description: Generate Turbo run summary metadata and parse it into structured `summary` when available (maps to --summarize)

tasks.description: Multiple Turbo tasks to run in one invocation (e.g., ['build','test'])

name: turbo
title: turbo
